measure: In silico, no new data: re-state what is established (this package) and re-read PDK/PDP/MPC/MCT/LDH transcripts in the held organoid, mouse and P47T tables, descriptively
decision_it_can_change: Which PDK and PDP isoforms and which transporters to read at protein level in step 2; it cannot change whether PDH is limited
executable: Executable now; closes nothing about activity

measure: FIRST PRACTICABLE COMPARISON. Matched-stage WWOX-deficient versus isogenic control human neural cells, same culture lot, in one sample series: total PDH E1-alpha protein, phosphorylation at all three E1 sites (not Ser293 alone), and PDH activity measured before and after dephosphorylation
decision_it_can_change: Separates three states: low amount (activity low, not rescued by dephosphorylation), phosphorylation-limited (activity low, restored by dephosphorylation), and normal. It decides whether any PDK/PDP-directed lever has a premise [Audit: add phosphatase-inhibitor lysis, a composition or maturity read-out, and actual versus total activity.]
executable: Laboratory. Needs an isogenic WWOX-deficient neural line or derivation; no deposit holds it (needs O13)

measure: If step 2 shows a difference: add PDK-isoform and PDP read-outs and a PDK-inhibited arm in the same cells
decision_it_can_change: Whether the change is kinase-driven, and which isoform; a Ser293-type site alone does not name the kinase (E34) [Audit: a pan-PDK inhibitor cannot name the isoform; use isoform-selective knockdown; DCA's neurotoxicity (E29-E31) argues for genetic arms.]

measure: Substrate-resolved respiration: OCR with pyruvate-fed and PDH-independent substrate sets, extracellular acidification corrected for respiratory CO2
decision_it_can_change: Whether cellular pyruvate oxidation, not lysate capacity, is limited; separates transport or downstream limits from PDH state [Audit: does not separate transport from PDH without a carrier-bypassing substrate or a carrier inhibitor.]

measure: Labelled-glucose tracing with absolute uptake, secretion and oxygen rates: citrate versus lactate labelling converted to flux
decision_it_can_change: Whether pyruvate carbon is diverted to lactate; enrichment alone does not give flux

measure: Lactate/pyruvate ratio with NADH/NAD+ and the cause arm (LDH-side change versus PDH-side change)
decision_it_can_change: Whether a lactate change comes from redox or from PDH; ratio alone cannot give the cause

measure: Intervention arms only where they separate hypotheses: PDK inhibition (tests phosphorylation limit), LDH reduction (tests lactate-side contribution), a PDH-bypassing substrate (tests supply versus PDH). Beta-hydroxybutyrate recovery alone does not show a PDH defect and is not a ketogenic-diet assessment
decision_it_can_change: Which of the three levers has a premise in the cells; not whether any is useful

measure: Functional outcome beside every metabolic read-out: network firing or activity-dependent ATP handling, viability, with and without a defined stress
decision_it_can_change: Lower lactate is not automatically beneficial and higher oxidation is not automatically harmful; benefit needs an outcome
executable: Laboratory; endpoints that separate symptomatic from developmental effect are not available in these cells
